name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-app:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Add Kotlin problem matcher
        uses: equeim/kotlin-problem-matcher@cd8d50db272bc44d8ecfac02dcc46ec9cd489a49

      - name: Set up Java 25
        uses: actions/setup-java@03ad4de0992f5dab5e18fcb136590ce7c4a0ac95
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 25

      - name: Set up Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@0723195856401067f7a2779048b490ace7a47d7c
        with:
          cache-read-only: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
          cache-encryption-key: ${{ secrets.GRADLE_ENCRYPTION_KEY }}

      - name: Build the app
        run: |
          ./gradlew build

      - name: Archive debug APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: debug-apk
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/fdroid/debug/app-fdroid-debug.apk
          retention-days: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 3 || github.retention_days }}

      - name: Archive unsigned release APKs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: unsigned-release-apks
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/*/release/*.apk
          retention-days: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 3 || github.retention_days }}

      - name: Archive test and lint reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: reports
          path: |
            app/build/reports/*
            billing/build/reports/*
            common/build/reports/*
            rpc/build/reports/*
            torrentfile/build/reports/*
          retention-days: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 3 || github.retention_days }}

  reuse-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Check REUSE compliance
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get --no-install-recommends --assume-yes install pipx
          pipx run reuse lint

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
